### Stock Return Prediction & Options Pricing

<span class="project-tech">Python · scikit-learn · XGBoost · Quantitative Finance</span>

Developed a machine learning pipeline to predict stock performance relative to the S&P 500, incorporating feature engineering, model comparison, backtesting, and options pricing.

**Highlights:** 20 stocks analyzed across four sectors; three classification models evaluated.

### MoodMate: Emotion Classification

<span class="project-tech">Python · NLP · TF-IDF · Random Forest</span>

Collaborated on an NLP pipeline to classify written text into six emotions using multiple machine learning models and text vectorization techniques.

**Highlights:** 89.85% Random Forest validation accuracy across six emotion classes.
:::

### Dating App User Behavior Analysis

<span class="project-tech">Tableau · Exploratory Data Analysis · Data Visualization</span>

Collaborated on an analysis of dating app datasets to explore how demographics, lifestyle characteristics, and user preferences relate to engagement and behavior.

**Highlights:** Data visualizations and regression analysis across three datasets.
